security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: An unofficial desktop workspace for Codex
bundle.longDescription: TuxCodex connects to the local Codex CLI and brings chats, projects, code review, approvals, and file previews into one desktop window. Developed by Moussa Kassim Mohame and Stefano Cacciatore.
